title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis), daily max temperature for a point location
summary: Gridded, model-based historical weather reanalysis served as JSON by point coordinates. For UC2 it can supply the daily maximum 2 m temperature (temperature_2m_max, °C) at a chosen northern-Italy location, with daily aggregates computed in a timezone of the caller's choice. Grain is hourly underlying, daily when requested. Probes confirmed responses for 2023-06-01, 2025-06-01 and 2026-03-30/31 at Milan-area coordinates; the shop's actual town is not named in any source, so the location is an assumption still to be set.

spatial.notes: Register default coordinates are 38.72 N, -9.14 (Lisbon, Portugal), which is outside the use case geography. Probes used 45.46 N, 9.19 E (Milan area), which the API snapped to grid point 45.448154, 9.169279, elevation 138 m. The shop's town is not named in any source, so the coordinates are an unverified assumption for the owner to confirm.

quality_notes: Register default_query uses Lisbon coordinates (38.72, -9.14) and timezone UTC; neither suits a northern-Italy shop. A daily maximum in UTC would split local days, so the query must set timezone=Europe/Rome (confirmed to return daily.time in local dates in probes) or the day boundary must be justified.

Data is modelled reanalysis on a grid, not station observations. The returned point (45.448154, 9.169279, 138 m) is a grid cell, not the shop's location; local heat exposure may differ. Disclose to owner.
Town not named in any source: coordinates used in probes (Milan area) are an illustration only and need an owner-confirmed assumption recorded in decisions.md.

Catalog candidate stated coverage 2023-06-01 to 2026-03-31. Confirmed by probes: 2023-06-01/02 returned (2 days), 2025-06-01/03 returned (3 days), 2026-03-30/31 returned (2 days). Coverage between those windows was not sampled and the archive's latest available date beyond 2026-03-31 was not tested.

Register default_query requests hourly variables; the probe responses also returned hourly temperature_2m and shortwave_radiation even when only daily was requested in the probe. Request only what is needed.
Upstream licences differ (see licence.mixed_sources). Copernicus C3S licence terms were not read; Legal review needed before production use.
